description: Use this when the user asks which businesses are connected or when their trade licence expires, or first, when another tool needs business_id and the connection may share more than one business. Lists the Fatura Go businesses the user shared with this connection: id, name, base currency, whether the business has a TRN (VAT registered), the user's role, whether it is read-only (closed) and the trade licence issue and expiry dates when the user entered them. Other tools take one of these ids as business_id. Do not use it for clients (list_clients) or for business figures (get_dashboard_summary).
name: list_businesses
title: List my businesses
